table: CDSS ACIN I-40-26 (FY2027 amounts, effective 2026-10-01 to 2027-09-30)
hsd_rule: California: the homeless shelter deduction ($205.66) applies only if the household pays some shelter cost, and it is subtracted directly from adjusted income (no 50% test, no utility allowance); if actual shelter cost plus a utility allowance gives a larger excess-shelter deduction, that is used instead. Free couch-surfing gets no shelter deduction.
conventions: Income is converted to monthly once (cents half-up; weekly x 4.33, biweekly x 2.167, semimonthly x 2, hourly x hours a week x 4.33); exact decimals after that; net income is rounded once to the dollar half-up; the 30% reduction is rounded up with integers; the first month is floored with integers; no float and no round() anywhere.
how_to_check: Load each `facts` object into the Facts model (every field is present) and evaluate it with the FY2027 table. `works_80h_month` and `receives_unemployment` feed only the work-rule yellow line (rules table abawd.yellow_when); both are false unless the case says otherwise. Compare every key present in `expected`; null means the value must be null. `amount` is the monthly estimate; `first_month` uses `apply_date` exactly as given (the weekday/5 PM filing estimate is a screen rule, not an engine rule). `expedited` is null until `cash_on_hand` is known. `expedited_screen` (ask the cash question) and `irt_applies` (show the income-reporting line on the card) are given for 'likely' cases and are evaluated for this facts world only. `normalize` checks the money normalizer for the pay basis the student stated. `trap` is the wrong value a common implementation mistake produces. `yellow_count` and `yellow_codes` count engine policy flags only (abawd_possible, income_changing_soon); case-level lines (the coordinator review line, ta_ra_income_type, VoI leftovers such as G10's other-utilities line) are tested at the dialogue level, which is why G3, G6-b and G10 show 0. Dialogue-level expectations (which questions are asked) live in the rules table's voi.required_results (G1, G1-b, G1-c, G6-b, G10) and in tests/e2e/scripts/. `today`, when a case gives it, is the day passed to the engine (N33: a day outside the table's effective dates); every other case is evaluated on a day inside them (the test clock is 2026-10-02). `route_step`, on the routing cases (source routing_coverage), names the rules table's decision_order step that decides the route.
hand_calc_note: Every expected value was calculated by hand first (hand_calc) and then checked against an independent re-implementation of the rules (zero mismatches on 2026-10-01).

cases.title: SF State junior: work $900/month, rent share $1,100, cash $1,000 (demo path)
cases.hand_calc: 1 person. Gross 900.00 <= 2,660. Adjusted 900 - 180 (20% of earned) - 217 = 503. Shelter 1,100 + 0 utility - 251.50 (half of 503) = 848.50 -> cap 769. Net 503 - 769 -> 0. Benefit 306 - ceil(0.3 x 0) = $306. IRT: 900 <= 1,729 -> IRT line. Expedited: cash question asked because 1,100 + 0 > 900; 900 < 150? no; 900 + 1,000 = 1,900 < 1,100? no -> false. First month, filed 2026-10-02 (counts 30 of 31 days): 306 x 30 // 31 = 296.

cases.title: Maria, but a parent pays all of the rent straight to the landlord
cases.hand_calc: Rent paid by someone else straight to the landlord: not income, and not her shelter cost -> own shelter 0. Adjusted 503. Shelter 0 - 251.50 -> 0. Net 503. 30%: ceil(150.9) = 151. 306 - 151 = $155.

cases.title: Maria with a separate heating/AC bill
cases.hand_calc: Heat/AC bill -> SUA 686. Shelter 1,100 + 686 - 251.50 = 1,534.50 -> cap 769. Net 503 - 769 -> 0. $306 (same as G1, so the heating question is not asked).

cases.hand_calc: 22 hours a week (20 or more) -> exemption work20h. 396 x 4.33 = 1,714.68. Adjusted 1,714.68 - 342.936 - 217 = 1,154.744. Shelter 1,000 - 577.372 = 422.628. cases.title: Couch-surfing, pays a friend $150, work $1,000, cash $60
cases.hand_calc: Homeless with a shelter cost. Adjusted 1,000 - 200 - 217 = 583. Actual excess 150 + 0 - 291.50 -> 0, smaller than 205.66 -> subtract the homeless deduction directly: 583 - 205.66 = 377.34 -> 377. 30%: ceil(113.1) = 114. 306 - 114 = $192. Expedited: 1,000 + 60 = 1,060 < 150? no -> false.

cases.title: Same, but pays nothing
cases.hand_calc: Pays nothing -> no homeless deduction. Net 583. 30%: ceil(174.9) = 175. 306 - 175 = $131. Expedited: 1,060 < 0? no -> false.

cases.hand_calc: Volunteered SSDI (never asked; only the route flag is kept, never the amount) -> different gross and net tests, an uncapped shelter deduction and a medical deduction apply -> coordinator.elderly_disabled. This step comes before school and age.

cases.title: Rules table not valid on the day: 2027-10-01
cases.hand_calc: 2027-10-01 is after the FY2027 table's effective dates (2026-10-01 to 2027-09-30) -> no estimate -> coordinator.unresolved; the case-level yellow line rules_not_valid is written when the case is updated and is not an engine flag.
